Listerine skill v1.0.0 — Everything about the world’s first mouthwash brand and its marketing legacy.

- Covers Listerine’s transformation from surgical antiseptic to market-leading mouthwash.
- Explains how Listerine invented and popularized the term “halitosis” to drive demand.
- Includes business model, moat analysis, and key facts about global growth.
- Ideal for those studying historic marketing, brand strategy, and fear-based advertising.
